# Copilot instructions

[AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root is the single source of conventions, build and test commands, and
project layout. Read it before making changes and follow it; do not rely on copies of its content elsewhere.

The design spec is in `docs/superpowers/specs/`. Behaviour that conflicts with the spec is a bug in the change or a
spec change that needs to be called out in the pull request.
